meta.title: Our Farm Trip Folder
meta.textType: a school text with five paragraph topics

paragraphs: Our Farm Trip Folder, posted by May. The Explorers will go to a farm next Saturday. The farm is nearly two hours from our school. It has cows, chickens, and a small lake. Teacher Kim gave every child a blue folder. The folder has a map, a list, and a letter. Do you know what is in a trip folder? I will tell you.

We will travel by coach. A coach is a big, comfortable bus for a long journey. It leaves from the school gate at seven o'clock. The journey takes nearly two hours, with a short stop on the way. Teacher Kim sits at the front, and the children sit in pairs. Please do not be late, because the coach will not wait. On the coach, we will sing songs and play a word game. Mia will look at the map and count the roads.

The folder has a page of instructions for the day. First, pack a hat, a bottle of water, and a raincoat. The weather may change, so the raincoat is important. Second, wear old shoes, because the ground at a farm is often wet. Third, bring your lunch in a small bag. Fourth, take a pen and a small notebook. I will write notes for the blog, and Lily will edit them. Leo asked, "Can I bring my camera?" The page says that Mia will take the photos, so Leo will leave his camera at home.

The folder also has a page about how to stay safe. A farm can be a place of danger for children. Do not touch the big machines. Do not walk behind a cow, and do not run near the animals. Some animals may be upset by noise, so please speak quietly. Stay with your group, and look at the map when you are not sure. A farmer will show us the animals and tell us about his work.

The last page of the folder is a letter from Teacher Kim. The letter begins with the words, "Dear parents," and then it gives the time and the plan. The letter also says that the trip is free. A parent must sign the letter and put it back in the folder. I showed the letter to my mom, and she signed it at once. Now my bag is nearly ready for the farm. Is your bag ready too?
text.summary: May tells the readers of Explorers' Blog about the folder for the farm trip. It has a map, instructions, a page about staying safe, and a letter for the parents. The Explorers travel by coach.
